title: summary.native spec
description: What a summary.native request asks for: an engine's own first-order summary of a system, as it presents it, at each requested line: the f-numbers it states and the pupil, stop, focal length and track they are of, each under the definition the contract names. Code checks that the lines are distinct.

lines.description: Indices of lines of the case, in conditions.lines, each once.
